item.description: The AIA (Italian Association of English Studies) PhD Day 2026 will take place at the University of Cagliari, both in person and online, on Friday 27th November. Designed to enhance the specialist training of doctoral candidates and early-career researchers, the AIA PhD Days offer a valuable forum for methodological discussion and reflection across the three main areas of English Studies: Linguistics and Translation Studies, Literature, and Cultural Studies. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 14th Southern African Microlinguistics Workshop
item.description: The Department of General Linguistics at Stellenbosch University is proud to be hosting the 14th Southern African Microlinguistics Workshop (SAMWOP-14) from Wednesday 2nd December to Friday 4th December, 2026. The programme for SAMWOP-14 is now available on the workshop website: https://sites.google.com/view/samwop-14/programme The programme comprises 27 papers over three days, with no parallel sessions. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: International Workshop - Interactional Functions of Syntax, Syntactic Functions of Interaction
item.description: A growing body of research across linguistic theory, conversation analysis, interactional linguistics, and usage-based approaches converges on a central insight: syntax and interaction are deeply intertwined and mutually constitutive. On the one hand, interaction provides the primary environment in which syntax is acquired, shaped, and made meaningful. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: Language in Healthcare: Second Language Teaching, Assessment and Learning Resources for Healthcare Professionals and Students in Nordic Vocational and Higher Education
item.description: This international Nordic conference will address how specialized language learning can improve workforce integration, patient safety and care quality across Nordic healthcare systems. With a particular focus on immigrant healthcare professionals and students in Nordic countries, the event will examine evidence-based teaching strategies, course designs, assessment and new technology (including GenAI) to enhance language competence that matters in the workplace. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors.
